svg.title: Six connected responsibilities in the yeast FACS workflow
svg.desc: User-supplied FCS, configuration and sample metadata feed ingest, acquisition diagnostics and declared selection. These logical stages produce measurements.json. FlowKit preprocessing and compensation occur before event summarization; quality diagnostics do not automatically remove events. Experiment assembly joins sample metadata and preserves comparison restrictions. It branches to a descriptive report and, optionally, sort-bin and decoded-count linkage. The run receipt hashes produced files. Amber human-review notes are advisory, not software approval gates. Future upstream adapters are not executed.
